data.description: Location: New York City A leading systematic hedge fund investing across a variety of global financial markets, my client is seeking a talented Quant Developer to join a growing front office team. Working directly with senior quant PMs and experienced engineers, your primary focus will be developing, maintaining and supporting all components of the team's trading systems. You'll also contribute to quality control and automated testing, apply software engineering best practices across the team, and develop automated, fault-tolerant systems functions for monitoring and tracking. The successful Quant Developer will have a strong work ethic, fantastic multi-tasking ability and a good sense of accountability. data.jobSummary: A leading systematic hedge fund in New York City seeks a Quant Developer to join its front office team. The role focuses on developing, maintaining, and supporting trading systems using C++ and Python, working directly with senior quant PMs and experienced engineers. Day-to-day responsibilities include building automated, fault-tolerant monitoring systems, contributing to quality control and automated testing, and applying software engineering best practices. The ideal candidate combines strong coding expertise in C++ (C++20 preferred) or Python with finance industry experience and a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. The position offers competitive base salaries, performance-based bonuses, and a collaborative culture where ideas are actively implemented.

data.jobSummary: Full-Stack Quant Developer role at a proprietary derivatives trading firm in Chicago. The position requires overseeing all firm software infrastructure while collaborating with quants and traders to develop next-generation trading systems and strategies. Core responsibilities include Python-based statistical analysis and backtesting on large datasets, web application development using Flask and Dash, Linux systems administration with bash scripting, and SQL database management with MySQL and SQLAlchemy. Requires minimum 2 years professional experience and mastery across full-stack technologies to support quantitative trading operations.

data.description: Location: New York or London Comp: 150-500k Summary A multi-strategy hedge fund focused on delivering consistent returns through innovative trading strategies, robust risk management, and cutting-edge technology. They're now seeking an exceptional quant developer to build core risk and treasury technology. As the business grows, this role is key in order to understand exposures, manage liquidity & cash, support funding decisions, and scale critical middle-office infrastructure. You will work on pivotal systems every day, partnering with stakeholders across the business, and will be expected to move comfortably between quantitative analysis, technology and trading. This role would be perfect for someone who enjoys meaningful ownership, high visibility and the chance to build critical technology. Requirements Professional software engineering skills Strong mathematical skills Excellent communication abilities across a range of technical understanding Able to collaborate effectively with a wide variety of colleagues in a demanding, fast-paced environment Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (or related field) Previous experience within financial services is a plus Benefits Competitive base salaries and performance-based bonuses Very collaborative culture, ideas are implemented Work with passionate, forward-thinking, incredibly smart people Whilst we carefully review all applications, to all jobs, due to the high volume of applications we receive it is not possible to respond to those who have not been successful.
